summary: 1–10, The Twelve are to send the gospel and raise the warning voice to all nations and people; 11–15, They are to take up their cross, follow Jesus, and feed His sheep; 16–20, Those who receive the First Presidency receive the Lord; 21–29, Darkness covers the earth, and only those who believe and are baptized will be saved; 30–34, The First Presidency and the Twelve hold the keys of the dispensation of the fulness of times.
meta_description: Revelation given through Joseph Smith the Prophet to Thomas B. Marsh, President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, at Kirtland, Ohio, July 23, 1837. At this time there was significant dissension in the Church over Joseph Smith’s leadership, including among some of the Apostles. In the months before this revelation was given, Thomas B. Marsh had worked to end the conflict among Church leaders and unite the Apostles.
